content.short: zkMe builds Identity Oracles using zero-knowledge proofs for secure, self-sovereign, private credential verification.
content.description: zkMe uses zero-knowledge proofs to verify user credentials without disclosing personal information. It is described as the only KYC solution that is fully decentralized, private-by-design, and compliant with global AML requirements. zkMe enables private, verifiable identities within regulated crypto businesses while preserving the Web3 ethos. By design, it lets organizations meet international AML standards without exposing sensitive data, supporting compliant participation in decentralized ecosystems.
